centaur: A centaur, ONE SINGLE FUSED CREATURE, the bare torso of a bearded man GROWING DIRECTLY OUT OF THE SHOULDERS OF A HORSE where the horse's neck would be. There is NO RIDER, NO SADDLE and NO HORSE'S HEAD - the man's torso replaces the horse's neck and head entirely. Chestnut coat, carrying a bow, isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
